convert_atoms_to_ase: convert an Atoms dataclass to an ASE Atoms object with fixed subsurface atom constraints
convert_relaxation_result_to_ase: convert an AdsorbateSlabRelaxationResult to an ASE Atoms object with energy and forces attached
create_relaxation_request: create an AdsorbateSlabRelaxationsRequest dataclass to submit a batch of adsorbate slab relaxations to the API
check_relaxation_status: check the Status enum values to determine if a relaxation succeeded, failed, or is not yet available
parse_slab_response: parse a Slabs response dataclass containing slab structures and metadata from the OCP API
